# Multinomial logistic results (tuning season)

*Generated by `pipeline/07_logistic.R` on 2026-10-08. Trained on 2023-2024, scored on 2025. 2026 is still untouched.*

## Headline

| model | log_loss | top1 | family_log_loss | family_top1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| L1 prior mix (Phase 1 baseline, relabel-repaired) | 1.558 | 39.2% | 0.914 | 55.8% |
| L2 + current form (proposed second baseline) | 1.368 | 41.1% | 0.885 | 56.6% |
| L3 + platoon tilt | 1.344 | 42.0% | 0.871 | 56.6% |

| Context model: all 8 pitches | 1.279 | 44.9% | 0.831 | 58.2% |

*Family columns collapse the 8 pitches to fastball / breaking / offspeed.*
